September 22, 2026


We're honoured to once again receive Gold certification through the[Canadian Council for Indigenous Business](https://facebook.com/681645201922352) 's Partnership Accreditation in Indigenous Relations (PAIR) program, our eighth consecutive certification. This recognition reflects something Cameco has believed since the beginning: the best outcomes happen when we work together. Through long-term partnerships with Indigenous Peoples and local communities, we've focused on creating shared opportunities, supporting local prosperity and building relationships rooted in trust and respect. Thank you to[Canadian Council for Indigenous Business](https://facebook.com/681645201922352) for your leadership and congratulations on 25 years of advancing Indigenous relations and economic reconciliation in Canada. We look forward to celebrating with fellow recipients at the PAIR Awards in October.
